outcomeNote: Mishna stating the rule and R' Eliezer's addition.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כׇּל מִצְוָה שֶׁהִיא תְּלוּיָה בָּאָרֶץ – אֵינָהּ נוֹהֶגֶת אֶלָּא בָּאָרֶץ, וְשֶׁאֵינָהּ תְּלוּיָה בָּאָרֶץ – נוֹהֶגֶת בֵּין בָּאָרֶץ בֵּין בְּחוּצָה לָאָרֶץ,
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Any mitzva that is dependent on the land [aretz] applies only in Eretz» Yisrael, «and» any mitzva «that is not dependent on the land applies both in Eretz» Yisrael «and outside of Eretz» Yisrael.

segments.he: חוּץ מִן הָעׇרְלָה וְכִלְאַיִם. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: אַף הֶחָדָשׁ.
segments.en: This is «apart from» the mitzvot of «orla and diverse kinds,» which apply even outside of Eretz Yisrael. «Rabbi Eliezer says:» This is the halakha «even» with regard to the prohibition to eat from the «new crop» before the omer offering has been brought on the sixteenth of Nisan.
